user.title: Roborock B01
user.description: Enable the live map camera, room cleaning and map/position data on top of the official Roborock integration. No login needed - it reuses that integration's session. Set up the official Roborock integration first.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. A single instance covers all B01 vacuums.

clean_segment.name: Clean segment (room)
clean_segment.description: Clean rooms by segment id on a B01 Q7/Q10 vacuum. Get the ids from the roborock.get_maps response. Works even where the segment repair flow is unavailable.

segment_id.name: Segment ids
segment_id.description: One or more room/segment ids, e.g. [16] or [16, 17].

map_failure.message: Could not fetch the map from the device.

position_not_found.message: The robot position is not present in the current map data.

invalid_segment.message: Invalid segment id(s): {segments}. Use numeric room ids from roborock.get_maps.
